# UX baseline and first-visitor walkthroughs

Structured heuristic evaluation by the redesigner (no real players took part). Baseline = the live site of release 9.0.5
(`main` 5f5fccf2, source `b06f1dd7`); "after" = branch `website-redesign` built locally.

## Baseline (before the redesign)

**Architecture:** static site generated by `website/build_site.py` from `website/src/` (registry, providers, templates,
locales for en/pt-BR/pl/es/de, one stylesheet, four scripts); 7 pages × 5 languages; the Tibia data page is a hash-routed
app (20 views) on TibiaData v4 with caching and a sanitiser; light/dark themes with no flash; GitHub Pages with `404.html`
deep-link redirects; Google Analytics 4. Protected paths in the Pages repository: `games/` (Pixel-Quill learning game),
`pokemon/` (Pokémon Learning Adventure), `tools/` (only `validate-pokemon.mjs`, a deployment check for `/pokemon/` – **no
Tibia tools**), `.github/`, `CNAME`, `robots.txt`. They use their own bundled CSS/JS, so the site's styles cannot affect them.

**Existing tools:** character lookup, worlds, guilds, highscores, houses, kill statistics, creatures, spells, boostable
bosses, fansites, news/archive/articles (all TibiaData). **No calculators existed**, so no formulas were touched.

**Problems found:**

| # | Problem | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| B1 | The home page opened as a download landing page (title "Tibia Foundry 9.0.5", app tagline, download button, app screenshot); the web tools came third | `home.html` order: hero (app) → news → tools |
| B2 | Seven equal header links + search needed 1180 px; phones and laptops below that saw only a menu | `styles.css` breakpoint 1180 px |
| B3 | Inconsistent naming: "Tibia Data" (nav) vs "Online Tibia tools" (home) vs "All Tibia data" | locales |
| B4 | Tool hub: 12 cards in one undifferentiated grid, text only | `data-app.js` hub |
| B5 | No breadcrumbs; on phones the data views hid the page lead, so context was thin | templates |
| B6 | Footer: no creator profiles, no links to Tibia.com/CipSoft or the Tibia Rules, no year, no privacy information | `layout.html` |
| B7 | Download page: no independent-software notice in the required wording, no release date, sizes, signing or scan statement | `downloads.html` |
| B8 | **Google Analytics was not disclosed anywhere** and could not be turned off | locales (no mention of analytics/cookies) |
| B9 | No statement on advertising, monetisation, programme status, moderation or content sources | – |
| B10 | Visual identity generic (blue accents taken from the desktop app), little Tibia character | `styles.css` tokens |
| B11 | Home page long on phones (two download sections, six feature cards plus news and creator) | screenshots |

## Walkthroughs (after the redesign)

Each task was walked on the built site at 390 px and 1440 px (screens in `production-screenshots/` and the scratch shots
taken during development).

| # | Task | Route / path | Steps | Unnecessary steps / confusing terms | Obstacles / abandonment risk | Result and remaining improvement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Understand what Tibia Foundry offers | Home, first screen | 0 | – | – | Headline names both offers (web tools + desktop toolkit); "Today in Tibia" shows live value. Could add a one-line "free, no account" badge under the headline (already in the lead) |
| 2 | Find a useful tool or resource | Home → "Find what you need" card or header "Tibia tools" | 1 | – | – | Six task cards with icons; hub groups 12 tools in 4 groups. No calculators exist yet (roadmap #1–#6) |
| 3 | Understand how to use a tool | Tibia tools → e.g. Highscores | 1–2 | – | Data tables are dense on phones but stack into records | Each view has controls with labels and a source line; future calculators need the "how this is calculated" block (roadmap #1–#2) |
| 4 | Locate the desktop download | Header "Download" (desktop) / menu "Downloads" (phone) / home "Get the desktop app" | 1 | – | – | Visible in the header at ≥ 1024 px and twice on the home page |
| 5 | Understand the download disclaimer | Home desktop-app section; Downloads page top | 0 extra | – | Notice is long (three sentences, required wording) | Shown above all download buttons with a shield icon; "Download safety and release information" link |
| 6 | Find information about the creator | Home "Made by a TibiaWiki editor" → About; footer | 1 | – | – | About page, footer profiles and Legal § administrator |
| 7 | Find credits and data acknowledgments | Footer "Data & resource credits" | 0 (scroll) | – | – | TibiaData thanked first, plus Tibia.com, CipSoft, TibiaWiki, fansites; Legal § Content sources |
| 8 | Change the language | Globe button (desktop) / menu "Language" (phone) / footer list | 1–2 | – | – | Plus the language offer bar for visitors whose browser prefers another language |
| 9 | Change the theme | Theme button (desktop) / menu (phone) | 1 | – | – | Stored per browser |
| 10 | Navigate between related resources | Breadcrumbs, hub groups, pill navigation, footer groups | 1 | – | – | Breadcrumb now shows "Home › Tibia tools › <view>" |
| 11 | Use the site comfortably on a phone | All pages at 320–430 px | – | – | – | No page-level horizontal overflow at 320/360/390/430 px (e2e `responsive`); ≥ 44 px primary targets; menu with icons; tables stack |

## Before/after summary

B1 home now leads with tasks and live data, with the app spotlight second · B2 header shows 4 task links + Download from
1024 px · B3 one name everywhere: "Tibia tools" · B4 grouped hub with pixel icons · B5 breadcrumbs on every inner page ·
B6 complete footer · B7 notice + release facts · B8 analytics disclosed with opt-out and GPC · B9 Legal & transparency page ·
B10 stone-and-parchment identity with original pixel art · B11 phone home page shortened (one download section, three
feature cards).
